title: Arc closing CTA
description: A near-black closing band: a big regular-weight heading over three lines on the left, one short dimmed line and a mint square-cornered button with a chevron. The heading, then the line and button, fade and rise 15px as they scroll into view.
notes: always dark: it puts the `dark` class on itself, so the button takes the theme's dark primary (mint in the arc theme)
